surah.personality_summary: Unique Qur'anic surah of 28 ayat revealed in Mecca, possessing its distinct thematic core, atmosphere, and rhetorical progression.
surah.opening_ending_dynamic: Connects opening theme to terminal resolution.
surah.overview: Surah Al-Jinn (The Jinn) is the 72th surah in the canonical muṣḥaf sequence, comprising 28 ayat. Classified as Makki.

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: قُلۡ أُوحِيَ إِلَيَّ أَنَّهُ ٱسۡتَمَعَ نَفَرࣱ مِّنَ ٱلۡجِنِّ فَقَالُوٓاْ إِنَّا سَمِعۡنَا قُرۡءَانًا عَجَبࣰ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ قُلْ أُوحِيَ إِلَيَّ أَنَّهُ اسْتَمَعَ نَفَرٌ مِنَ الْجِنِّ فَقَالُوا إِنَّا سَمِعْنَا قُرْآنًا عَجَبًا
ayahs.arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم قل اوحي الي انه استمع نفر من الجن فقالوا انا سمعنا قرانا عجبا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Say, [O Muhammad], "It has been revealed to me that a group of the jinn listened and said, 'Indeed, we have heard an amazing Qur'an
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Say [Prophet], ‘It has been revealed to me that a group of jinn once listened in and said, “We have heard a wondrous Quran

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: يَهۡدِيٓ إِلَى ٱلرُّشۡدِ فَـَٔامَنَّا بِهِۦۖ وَلَن نُّشۡرِكَ بِرَبِّنَآ أَحَدࣰ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: يَهْدِي إِلَى الرُّشْدِ فَآمَنَّا بِهِ ۖ وَلَنْ نُشْرِكَ بِرَبِّنَا أَحَدًا
ayahs.arabic_clean: يهدي الى الرشد فامنا به ۖ ولن نشرك بربنا احدا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: It guides to the right course, and we have believed in it. And we will never associate with our Lord anyone
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: that gives guidance to the right path, and we have come to believe it––We shall never set up partners with our Lord––

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَأَنَّهُۥ تَعَٰلَىٰ جَدُّ رَبِّنَا مَا ٱتَّخَذَ صَٰحِبَةࣰ وَلَا وَلَدࣰ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَأَنَّهُ تَعَالَىٰ جَدُّ رَبِّنَا مَا اتَّخَذَ صَاحِبَةً وَلَا وَلَدًا
ayahs.arabic_clean: وانه تعالى جد ربنا ما اتخذ صاحبة ولا ولدا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And [it teaches] that exalted is the nobleness of our Lord; He has not taken a wife or a son
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and that He––exalted be the glory of our Lord!––has neither spouse nor child

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَأَنَّهُۥ كَانَ يَقُولُ سَفِيهُنَا عَلَى ٱللَّهِ شَطَطࣰ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَأَنَّهُ كَانَ يَقُولُ سَفِيهُنَا عَلَى اللَّهِ شَطَطًا
ayahs.arabic_clean: وانه كان يقول سفيهنا على الله شططا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And that our foolish one has been saying about Allah an excessive transgression
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Outrageous things have been said about God by the foolish among us

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّآ أَن لَّن تَقُولَ ٱلۡإِنسُ وَٱلۡجِنُّ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبࣰ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّا أَنْ لَنْ تَقُولَ الْإِنْسُ وَالْجِنُّ عَلَى اللَّهِ كَذِبًا
ayahs.arabic_clean: وانا ظننا ان لن تقول الانس والجن على الله كذبا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And we had thought that mankind and the jinn would never speak about Allah a lie
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: although we had thought that no man or jinn would [dare to] tell a lie about Him

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَأَنَّهُۥ كَانَ رِجَالࣱ مِّنَ ٱلۡإِنسِ يَعُوذُونَ بِرِجَالࣲ مِّنَ ٱلۡجِنِّ فَزَادُوهُمۡ رَهَقࣰ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَأَنَّهُ كَانَ رِجَالٌ مِنَ الْإِنْسِ يَعُوذُونَ بِرِجَالٍ مِنَ الْجِنِّ فَزَادُوهُمْ رَهَقًا
ayahs.arabic_clean: وانه كان رجال من الانس يعوذون برجال من الجن فزادوهم رهقا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And there were men from mankind who sought refuge in men from the jinn, so they [only] increased them in burden
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Men have sought refuge with the jinn in the past, but they only misguided them further

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَأَنَّهُمۡ ظَنُّواْ كَمَا ظَنَنتُمۡ أَن لَّن يَبۡعَثَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدࣰ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَأَنَّهُمْ ظَنُّوا كَمَا ظَنَنْتُمْ أَنْ لَنْ يَبْعَثَ اللَّهُ أَحَدًا
ayahs.arabic_clean: وانهم ظنوا كما ظننتم ان لن يبعث الله احدا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And they had thought, as you thought, that Allah would never send anyone [as a messenger]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: They thought, as you did, that God would never raise anyone from the dead

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَأَنَّا لَمَسۡنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ فَوَجَدۡنَٰهَا مُلِئَتۡ حَرَسࣰ ا شَدِيدࣰ ا وَشُهُبࣰ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَأَنَّا لَمَسْنَا السَّمَاءَ فَوَجَدْنَاهَا مُلِئَتْ حَرَسًا شَدِيدًا وَشُهُبًا
ayahs.arabic_clean: وانا لمسنا السماء فوجدناها ملئت حرسا شديدا وشهبا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And we have sought [to reach] the heaven but found it filled with powerful guards and burning flames
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: We tried to reach heaven, but discovered it to be full of stern guards and shooting stars––

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَأَنَّا كُنَّا نَقۡعُدُ مِنۡهَا مَقَٰعِدَ لِلسَّمۡعِۖ فَمَن يَسۡتَمِعِ ٱلۡأٓنَ يَجِدۡ لَهُۥ شِهَابࣰ ا رَّصَدࣰ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَأَنَّا كُنَّا نَقْعُدُ مِنْهَا مَقَاعِدَ لِلسَّمْعِ ۖ فَمَنْ يَسْتَمِعِ الْآنَ يَجِدْ لَهُ شِهَابًا رَصَدًا
ayahs.arabic_clean: وانا كنا نقعد منها مقاعد للسمع ۖ فمن يستمع الان يجد له شهابا رصدا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And we used to sit therein in positions for hearing, but whoever listens now will find a burning flame lying in wait for him
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: we used to sit in places there, listening, but anyone trying to listen now will find a shooting star lying in wait for him––

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَأَنَّا لَا نَدۡرِيٓ أَشَرٌّ أُرِيدَ بِمَن فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ أَمۡ أَرَادَ بِهِمۡ رَبُّهُمۡ رَشَدࣰ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَأَنَّا لَا نَدْرِي أَشَرٌّ أُرِيدَ بِمَنْ فِي الْأَرْضِ أَمْ أَرَادَ بِهِمْ رَبُّهُمْ رَشَدًا
ayahs.arabic_clean: وانا لا ندري اشر اريد بمن في الارض ام اراد بهم ربهم رشدا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And we do not know [therefore] whether evil is intended for those on earth or whether their Lord intends for them a right course
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: [so now] we do not know whether those who live on earth are due for misfortune, or whether their Lord intends to guide them

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلصَّٰلِحُونَ وَمِنَّا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَۖ كُنَّا طَرَآئِقَ قِدَدࣰ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا الصَّالِحُونَ وَمِنَّا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ ۖ كُنَّا طَرَائِقَ قِدَدًا
ayahs.arabic_clean: وانا منا الصالحون ومنا دون ذلك ۖ كنا طرائق قددا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And among us are the righteous, and among us are [others] not so; we were [of] divided ways
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Some of us are righteous and others less so: we follow different paths

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّآ أَن لَّن نُّعۡجِزَ ٱللَّهَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَلَن نُّعۡجِزَهُۥ هَرَبࣰ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّا أَنْ لَنْ نُعْجِزَ اللَّهَ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَنْ نُعْجِزَهُ هَرَبًا
ayahs.arabic_clean: وانا ظننا ان لن نعجز الله في الارض ولن نعجزه هربا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And we have become certain that we will never cause failure to Allah upon earth, nor can we escape Him by flight
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: We know we can never frustrate God on earth; we can never escape Him

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَأَنَّا لَمَّا سَمِعۡنَا ٱلۡهُدَىٰٓ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦۖ فَمَن يُؤۡمِنۢ بِرَبِّهِۦ فَلَا يَخَافُ بَخۡسࣰ ا وَلَا رَهَقࣰ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَأَنَّا لَمَّا سَمِعْنَا الْهُدَىٰ آمَنَّا بِهِ ۖ فَمَنْ يُؤْمِنْ بِرَبِّهِ فَلَا يَخَافُ بَخْسًا وَلَا رَهَقًا
ayahs.arabic_clean: وانا لما سمعنا الهدى امنا به ۖ فمن يؤمن بربه فلا يخاف بخسا ولا رهقا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And when we heard the guidance, we believed in it. And whoever believes in his Lord will not fear deprivation or burden
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: When we heard the guidance we came to believe: whoever believes in his Lord need fear no loss nor injustice

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلۡمُسۡلِمُونَ وَمِنَّا ٱلۡقَٰسِطُونَۖ فَمَنۡ أَسۡلَمَ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ تَحَرَّوۡاْ رَشَدࣰ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا الْمُسْلِمُونَ وَمِنَّا الْقَاسِطُونَ ۖ فَمَنْ أَسْلَمَ فَأُولَٰئِكَ تَحَرَّوْا رَشَدًا
ayahs.arabic_clean: وانا منا المسلمون ومنا القاسطون ۖ فمن اسلم فاولئك تحروا رشدا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And among us are Muslims [in submission to Allah], and among us are the unjust. And whoever has become Muslim - those have sought out the right course
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Some of us submit to Him and others go the wrong way: those who submit to God have found wise guidance

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَأَمَّا ٱلۡقَٰسِطُونَ فَكَانُواْ لِجَهَنَّمَ حَطَبࣰ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَأَمَّا الْقَاسِطُونَ فَكَانُوا لِجَهَنَّمَ حَطَبًا
ayahs.arabic_clean: واما القاسطون فكانوا لجهنم حطبا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: But as for the unjust, they will be, for Hell, firewood
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: but those who go wrong will be fuel for Hellfire.” ’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَأَلَّوِ ٱسۡتَقَٰمُواْ عَلَى ٱلطَّرِيقَةِ لَأَسۡقَيۡنَٰهُم مَّآءً غَدَقࣰ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَأَنْ لَوِ اسْتَقَامُوا عَلَى الطَّرِيقَةِ لَأَسْقَيْنَاهُمْ مَاءً غَدَقًا
ayahs.arabic_clean: وان لو استقاموا على الطريقة لاسقيناهم ماء غدقا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And [Allah revealed] that if they had remained straight on the way, We would have given them abundant provision
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: If they had taken to the right way, We would have given them abundant water to drink

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: لِّنَفۡتِنَهُمۡ فِيهِۚ وَمَن يُعۡرِضۡ عَن ذِكۡرِ رَبِّهِۦ يَسۡلُكۡهُ عَذَابࣰ ا صَعَدࣰ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: لِنَفْتِنَهُمْ فِيهِ ۚ وَمَنْ يُعْرِضْ عَنْ ذِكْرِ رَبِّهِ يَسْلُكْهُ عَذَابًا صَعَدًا
ayahs.arabic_clean: لنفتنهم فيه ۚ ومن يعرض عن ذكر ربه يسلكه عذابا صعدا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: So We might test them therein. And whoever turns away from the remembrance of his Lord He will put into arduous punishment
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: a test for them––but anyone who turns away from his Lord’s Revelation will be sent by Him to spiralling torment

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَأَنَّ ٱلۡمَسَٰجِدَ لِلَّهِ فَلَا تَدۡعُواْ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ أَحَدࣰ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَأَنَّ الْمَسَاجِدَ لِلَّهِ فَلَا تَدْعُوا مَعَ اللَّهِ أَحَدًا
ayahs.arabic_clean: وان المساجد لله فلا تدعوا مع الله احدا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And [He revealed] that the masjids are for Allah, so do not invoke with Allah anyone
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Places of worship are for God alone- so do not pray to anyone other than God

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَأَنَّهُۥ لَمَّا قَامَ عَبۡدُ ٱللَّهِ يَدۡعُوهُ كَادُواْ يَكُونُونَ عَلَيۡهِ لِبَدࣰ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَأَنَّهُ لَمَّا قَامَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ يَدْعُوهُ كَادُوا يَكُونُونَ عَلَيْهِ لِبَدًا
ayahs.arabic_clean: وانه لما قام عبد الله يدعوه كادوا يكونون عليه لبدا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And that when the Servant of Allah stood up supplicating Him, they almost became about him a compacted mass
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: yet when God’s Servant stood up to pray to Him, they pressed in on him

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: قُلۡ إِنَّمَآ أَدۡعُواْ رَبِّي وَلَآ أُشۡرِكُ بِهِۦٓ أَحَدࣰ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: قُلْ إِنَّمَا أَدْعُو رَبِّي وَلَا أُشْرِكُ بِهِ أَحَدًا
ayahs.arabic_clean: قل انما ادعو ربي ولا اشرك به احدا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Say, [O Muhammad], "I only invoke my Lord and do not associate with Him anyone
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Say, ‘I pray to my Lord alone; I set up no partner with Him.’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: قُلۡ إِنِّي لَآ أَمۡلِكُ لَكُمۡ ضَرࣰّ ا وَلَا رَشَدࣰ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: قُلْ إِنِّي لَا أَمْلِكُ لَكُمْ ضَرًّا وَلَا رَشَدًا
ayahs.arabic_clean: قل اني لا املك لكم ضرا ولا رشدا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Say, "Indeed, I do not possess for you [the power of] harm or right direction
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Say, ‘I have no control over any harm or good that may befall you.’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: قُلۡ إِنِّي لَن يُجِيرَنِي مِنَ ٱللَّهِ أَحَدࣱ وَلَنۡ أَجِدَ مِن دُونِهِۦ مُلۡتَحَدًا
ayahs.arabic_simple: قُلْ إِنِّي لَنْ يُجِيرَنِي مِنَ اللَّهِ أَحَدٌ وَلَنْ أَجِدَ مِنْ دُونِهِ مُلْتَحَدًا
ayahs.arabic_clean: قل اني لن يجيرني من الله احد ولن اجد من دونه ملتحدا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Say, "Indeed, there will never protect me from Allah anyone [if I should disobey], nor will I find in other than Him a refuge
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Say, ‘No one can protect me from God: I have no refuge except in Him

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: إِلَّا بَلَٰغࣰ ا مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرِسَٰلَٰتِهِۦۚ وَمَن يَعۡصِ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ فَإِنَّ لَهُۥ نَارَ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًا
ayahs.arabic_simple: إِلَّا بَلَاغًا مِنَ اللَّهِ وَرِسَالَاتِهِ ۚ وَمَنْ يَعْصِ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ فَإِنَّ لَهُ نَارَ جَهَنَّمَ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا أَبَدًا
ayahs.arabic_clean: الا بلاغا من الله ورسالاته ۚ ومن يعص الله ورسوله فان له نار جهنم خالدين فيها ابدا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: But [I have for you] only notification from Allah, and His messages." And whoever disobeys Allah and His Messenger - then indeed, for him is the fire of Hell; they will abide therein forever
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: I only deliver [what I receive] from God- only His messages.’ Whoever disobeys God and His Messenger will have Hell’s Fire as his permanent home

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا رَأَوۡاْ مَا يُوعَدُونَ فَسَيَعۡلَمُونَ مَنۡ أَضۡعَفُ نَاصِرࣰ ا وَأَقَلُّ عَدَدࣰ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: حَتَّىٰ إِذَا رَأَوْا مَا يُوعَدُونَ فَسَيَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ أَضْعَفُ نَاصِرًا وَأَقَلُّ عَدَدًا
ayahs.arabic_clean: حتى اذا راوا ما يوعدون فسيعلمون من اضعف ناصرا واقل عددا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: [The disbelievers continue] until, when they see that which they are promised, then they will know who is weaker in helpers and less in number
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: when they are confronted by what they have been warned about, they will realize who has the weaker protector and the smaller number

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: قُلۡ إِنۡ أَدۡرِيٓ أَقَرِيبࣱ مَّا تُوعَدُونَ أَمۡ يَجۡعَلُ لَهُۥ رَبِّيٓ أَمَدًا
ayahs.arabic_simple: قُلْ إِنْ أَدْرِي أَقَرِيبٌ مَا تُوعَدُونَ أَمْ يَجْعَلُ لَهُ رَبِّي أَمَدًا
ayahs.arabic_clean: قل ان ادري اقريب ما توعدون ام يجعل له ربي امدا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Say, "I do not know if what you are promised is near or if my Lord will grant for it a [long] period
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Say, ‘I do not know whether what you have been warned about is near, or whether a distant time has been appointed for it by my Lord.’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: عَٰلِمُ ٱلۡغَيۡبِ فَلَا يُظۡهِرُ عَلَىٰ غَيۡبِهِۦٓ أَحَدًا
ayahs.arabic_simple: عَالِمُ الْغَيْبِ فَلَا يُظْهِرُ عَلَىٰ غَيْبِهِ أَحَدًا
ayahs.arabic_clean: عالم الغيب فلا يظهر على غيبه احدا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: [He is] Knower of the unseen, and He does not disclose His [knowledge of the] unseen to anyone
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: He is the One who knows what is hidden

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: إِلَّا مَنِ ٱرۡتَضَىٰ مِن رَّسُولࣲ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَسۡلُكُ مِنۢ بَيۡنِ يَدَيۡهِ وَمِنۡ خَلۡفِهِۦ رَصَدࣰ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: إِلَّا مَنِ ارْتَضَىٰ مِنْ رَسُولٍ فَإِنَّهُ يَسْلُكُ مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِ رَصَدًا
ayahs.arabic_clean: الا من ارتضى من رسول فانه يسلك من بين يديه ومن خلفه رصدا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Except whom He has approved of messengers, and indeed, He sends before each messenger and behind him observers
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: He does not disclose it except to a messenger of His choosing. He sends watchers to go in front and behind

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: لِّيَعۡلَمَ أَن قَدۡ أَبۡلَغُواْ رِسَٰلَٰتِ رَبِّهِمۡ وَأَحَاطَ بِمَا لَدَيۡهِمۡ وَأَحۡصَىٰ كُلَّ شَيۡءٍ عَدَدَۢا
ayahs.arabic_simple: لِيَعْلَمَ أَنْ قَدْ أَبْلَغُوا رِسَالَاتِ رَبِّهِمْ وَأَحَاطَ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ وَأَحْصَىٰ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ عَدَدًا
ayahs.arabic_clean: ليعلم ان قد ابلغوا رسالات ربهم واحاط بما لديهم واحصى كل شيء عددا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: That he may know that they have conveyed the messages of their Lord; and He has encompassed whatever is with them and has enumerated all things in number
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: to ensure that each of His messengers delivers his Lord’s message: He knows all about them, and He takes account of everything
